title: Cartesianity of glued model charts
statement: theorem glued_model_chart_pullbacks : each glued chart square is a pullback under the local cartesian hypotheses.

proof.text: Construct the descended overlaps and glue the schemes and morphisms, then verify the claimed property.

mathlib_searches.query: glued scheme chart pullback exact theorem
gluing local effective models with cartesian open charts

lean.statement:
theorem glued_model_chart_pullbacks
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} {V : Over X}
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens) (W : I → Over Y)
    (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (W₀ : Over Y) (q₀ : V.left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (j : ∀ i, (W i).left ⟶ W₀.left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i))
    (hcover : ∀ w : W₀.left, ∃ i, ∃ z : (W i).left, j i z = w)
    (hover : ∀ i, j i ≫ W₀.hom = (W i).hom)
    (hcomm : ∀ i, q i ≫ j i = (U i).ι ≫ q₀) :
    ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) (U i).ι (j i) q₀
